latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Agent Browser CLI, a fast Rust-based headless browser automation tool.

- Supports navigation, clicking, typing, and structured page snapshots via command line.
- Provides easy interaction with web elements using references (@e1, @e2) from snapshots.
- Includes commands for extracting data, filling forms, taking screenshots, PDFs, and recording video of sessions.
- Enables programmatic control of tabs, windows, frames, dialogs, storage, cookies, and network routes.
- Offers semantic locators (role, text, label) as alternatives to element refs for robust automation.
- Compatible with Node.js as a fallback; installation instructions included for npm and source.
